data.value: Trace at least 6 points along one line, from the inside out, covering inner, middle and outer positions.

data.name: calibration.warning.narrowCoverage
data.value: The points cover too narrow a band to separate the two radii; add points further in and further out.

data.name: calibration.warning.narrowBand
data.value: The traced band is narrow, so the parameters may compensate each other; add points further in and out.

data.name: calibration.warning.turnsBack
data.value: The curve clearly turns back inwards; trace from the inside out along a single line.

data.name: calibration.warning.halfTurnGap
data.value: Two neighbouring points are almost half a turn apart, so a missed turn cannot be ruled out; add points between them along the line.

data.name: calibration.warning.halfTurnRisk
data.value: Some neighbouring points are almost half a turn apart; add points and check again.

data.name: calibration.warning.thinned
data.value: Many points: the fit used an evenly thinned subset; the full order was still used to follow the line.

data.name: calibration.warning.noValidModel
data.value: No valid curve in the search range covers every point; check the photo scale, the centre or the search range.

data.name: calibration.warning.beyondBand
data.value: Some points fall outside the pattern band under this model and were kept as one continuous line; check the scale, the centre and the end points.

data.name: calibration.warning.largeResidual
data.value: The curve is far from the points; check the rectification, the points and that they follow one line.

data.name: calibration.warning.searchBoundary
data.value: The best result is near the edge of the search range; widen it and add points to check.

data.name: calibration.warning.similarConstraints
data.value: The points constrain both radii in a similar way, so a low residual does not yet prove a unique result; trace a wider band.

data.name: calibration.warning.nearCandidates
data.value: Some candidates have nearly the same shape; compare the whole curve before applying.

data.name: calibration.warning.limitedSearch
data.value: The wide search used a limited number of starting points; the list may not hold every possible result.

data.name: calibration.warning.unwrapAssumption
data.value: Following the line assumes no full turn is missed between neighbouring points; compare the whole curve and add points where it bends.

data.name: calibration.warning.pitchNeedsPoints
data.value: Fitting the DVD track terms needs at least 12 points at different radii over 60% of the drawing; only the radii were fitted.

data.name: calibration.warning.pitchFitted
data.value: The DVD track terms were fitted; they and the radii can compensate each other, so check the whole predicted curve before applying.

data.name: calibration.warning.pitchNoGain
data.value: Fitting the track terms gave no stable improvement; the original terms were kept.

data.name: calibration.warning.pitchUnstable
data.value: These points cannot separate the three track terms from the radii; the original terms were kept. Trace a wider band more precisely.

data.name: calibration.warning.pitchBoundary
data.value: A track term is near the edge of its search range; check the points.

data.name: calibration.warning.turnTooLarge
data.value: Neighbouring points turn too far apart; add points between them.
